text: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awards the 2026 Peace Prize to Navanethem Pillay, former ICC judge and UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. Her judicial record spans international prosecution of war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.

meta.note: The award recognizes an established legal record; committee statements are not treated as independent validation of outcomes.

text: Delta lowers 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.10-$5.60 and free cash flow to $2.5 billion. Jet fuel reaches $4.34 per gallon. Q3 net income falls 47% despite 21% operating revenue growth. Premium revenue rises 18%, with higher fares and sustained bookings.

meta.note: Revised guidance and reported earnings are distinct measures; demand strength is based on management statements.
